title: kate-ui: start plain text at the checkpoint
summary: A zero budget that straddles the checkpoint keeps color before that line. A viewport behind the checkpoint stays colored. The test goes in the existing highlight tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn highlight_step(checkpoint: u32, first: u32, last: u32, budget: u32) -> HighlightStep

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: highlight.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Keep highlight_step pub(crate). Replace the budget == 0 block with three separate returns. Keep the earlier if last < first. First: if budget == 0 && last < checkpoint { return HighlightStep { ensure_through: None, plain_from: None }; }. Second: if budget == 0 && first < checkpoint { return HighlightStep { ensure_through: None, plain_from: Some(checkpoint) }; }. Third: if budget == 0 { return HighlightStep { ensure_through: None, plain_from: Some(first) }; }. Each condition is one comparison or one &&. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch the later checkpoint checks or resume_color_line. The existing test a_zero_budget_keeps_color_behind_the_checkpoint stays green. The test a_zero_budget_starts_plain_at_the_checkpoint calls highlight_step(100, 10, 150, 0). ensure_through is None. plain_from is Some(100). Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: highlight::tests::a_zero_budget_starts_plain_at_the_checkpoint
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. highlight_step of 100, 10, 150, 0 paints plain from 10. After the change plain starts at 100. A viewport fully behind the checkpoint still has no plain start.
